title: Mick’s Green Tomato Chutney
ingredients: 2inch piece of root ginger thinly chopped
method: Put all ingredients in a big pan and bring to boil. Simmer for 1½ to 5 hours. Drain some of the vinegar if necessary. Fill clean, sterile, hot (put in oven on gas mark 2 for ½ hour) jars to top and seal with plastic and rubber bands. Leave for one month before eating.
details: Category: Condiments, Jams, Preserves, Pickles and Sauces
